assets.name: score-plain.png
assets.shows: The opening four bars of the Minuet in G transposed to C on one treble staff, 3/4, black on white, nothing highlighted.
assets.use: The cold open under the piano, and the closing play-through.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of the four bars engraved on one treble staff …>` type component

assets.name: abc-full.png
assets.shows: White frame, monospace: the header lines X:1, M:3/4, L:1/4, K:C and below them the melody line of four bars with bar lines.
assets.use: The hook, when the text first appears, and again before the last play-through.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of the whole ABC text …>` type component

assets.name: abc-header.png
assets.shows: The four header lines in red with gray labels: tune number; meter, three beats a bar; a letter lasts one beat; key C, no sharps or flats. The melody line below in gray.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of the same ABC text with only the header lines in red …>` type component

assets.name: pitch-c.png
assets.role: C and c on the staff
assets.shows: Two treble staves side by side: middle C as a half note on its ledger line labelled C, middle C, and the C an octave up labelled c, one octave higher.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of a treble staff with … middle C … and the C an octave up …>` type component

assets.name: length-slash.png
assets.shows: Two treble staves: one quarter note C labelled C, 1 beat; two beamed eighth notes labelled C/ C/, 1 beat.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of two panels side by side: "C" over a single quarter note, and "C/ C/" …>` type component

assets.name: bar-1.png
assets.shows: The four engraved bars with bar 1 in red and the others gray; below, the ABC melody line with bar 1's text in red.
assets.use: While the narration walks through bar 1.

assets.name: minuet-piano.mp3
assets.shows: The four bars on a plain grand piano (FluidR3), 110 quarter notes a minute, 8.0 s with a soft start and a 1 s fade.
assets.use: The cold open, at full level, before anything is spoken.
assets.binds_to: an `<audio of the first four bars of the Minuet … on a plain piano …>` type component

assets.name: minuet-piano-end.mp3
assets.shows: The same 8.0 s piano rendering, a separate file for the last play-through.
assets.use: The payoff, at full level, after the last spoken line.
assets.binds_to: an `<audio of the four bars of the Minuet on piano again …>` type component

assets.name: narration-master.mp3
assets.shows: The seven narration takes in a voice cloned with F5-TTS from Eidee's own recorded narration (with her consent), laid on one track at the measured clock, file time equal to reel time. Transcript: "That's the opening of the Minuet in G from Anna Magdalena Bach's notebook Here it is in C written as a single line of text The lines at the top set the rules M is the meter three beats in every bar L is the default length so a plain letter lasts one beat And K is the key C which means no sharps or flats Each letter is a note A capital C is middle C and a lowercase c is the C one octave higher A slash cuts a note in half So C slash is an eighth note half a beat and two of them fill the space of one plain C Bar one is G for one beat then C D E F as four quick eighth notes One beat plus four halves makes three Bar two is G C C Three plain letters three beats Bar three is the same shape as bar one a step higher: A then F G A B And bar four jumps up to the high c then back down to C C Every bar should add up to three If one doesn't then a note is missing or a bar line is in the wrong place That's the whole idea Four bars of music in about forty characters Here it is again"
assets.binds_to: every spoken `<...>` narration component — the voice itself
